settings.title: Support shaped around
settings.intro: No two students learn the same way, so no two tutoring plans should either. We start with a diagnostic and build a plan around how your child actually thinks.

features.title: Math & algebra
features.text: From fractions to calculus, we rebuild the foundations that make advanced math feel intuitive instead of intimidating.

features.title: Science & physics
features.text: Hands-on, concept-first science tutoring that turns abstract laws into things you can picture, test, and trust.

features.title: Coding & computer science
features.text: Learn to think like a programmer — Python, web basics, and AP Computer Science — with projects you're proud to show off.

features.title: Test prep
features.text: Focused prep for SAT, ACT, and AP exams with real practice tests, strategy, and the confidence that comes from being ready.

features.title: Homework & study skills
features.text: Weekly support that keeps students on track and teaches the study habits that make independent learning possible.

features.title: Homeschool support
features.text: A consistent STEM partner for homeschool families — curriculum guidance, assessments, and a tutor who knows your learner.

settings.title: A method, not
settings.intro: Great tutoring is a process. Here's how we take a student from stuck to confident.

design.title: Free diagnostic assessment
design.text: A 45-minute session with a senior tutor to find exactly where the gaps are — and what motivates your student. You get a written plan, no obligation.

build.title: Weekly one-on-one sessions
build.text: Consistent sessions with the same tutor, using a mix of direct instruction, guided practice, and real-world problems that make the material stick.

launch.title: Independence that lasts
launch.text: As confidence grows, we shift from teaching to coaching — until your student can tackle new problems on their own. We celebrate the day they don't need us.

settings.title: From first call to
settings.intro: Getting started is simple, and the first step is always free.

steps.title: Book a free assessment
steps.text: Tell us a little about your student and pick a time. We'll match you with a senior tutor for a 45-minute diagnostic — no cost, no commitment.

steps.title: Get your plan
steps.text: Within 48 hours you'll receive a written learning plan: the gaps we found, the goals we'll target, and the tutor we recommend.

steps.title: Start weekly sessions
steps.text: Meet your tutor for regular one-on-one sessions, in person or online. You'll get a progress report after every single session.

steps.title: Watch confidence grow
steps.text: Students don't just improve grades — they start asking better questions. We review progress every month and adjust the plan as they grow.

settings.note: Most families see measurable improvement within 8–10 sessions, and we review progress together every month so you always know where things stand.

settings.title: Questions parents
settings.intro: The honest answers to the questions we hear most often before a family books their first session.

items.question: How much does tutoring cost?
items.answer: One-on-one sessions range from $55–$85 per hour depending on the tutor's experience and subject. Small-group sessions (max 4 students) start at $35 per hour. The diagnostic assessment is always free.

items.question: Are your tutors actually qualified?
items.answer: Yes. Every tutor is either a certified teacher or a working STEM professional with a background in education. We interview, background-check, and train every tutor, and we match them to your student's needs and personality.

items.question: In-person or online?
items.answer: Both. We have two tutoring centres in Austin, and we offer live online sessions with the same tutors and the same interactive tools. Many families switch between the two week to week.

items.question: How quickly will we see results?
items.answer: Most students show measurable improvement within 8–10 sessions. You'll get a written progress report after every session, and we review the overall plan with you monthly so you always know where things stand.
